column1: # EZ LYNK custom configuration - GM E41 L5P - HP Tuners SOTF OS 69709843 - cal E2015G5138011_P2B
# Park/Neutral (stationary) driver demand table: GM name KtDTRC_M_EngTrqReqForRPM
# Addresses are byte offsets in the exported SOTF .bin (ECU CPU addresses are in DESC). Data is big-endian (MSB).
# Z = signed 16-bit raw; raw x 0.25 = Nm; Math 0.1843905 converts raw to lb-ft. Axes are 32-bit floats.

# Layout: X axis = across the top (RPM) and Y axis = down the side (pedal % or load). Check: Park/Neutral table - the 100% pedal row (bottom) reads 1408.6 563.3 328.6 211.1 140.7 93.9 60.3 26.4 2.2 left to right (stock).

column4: KtDTRC_M_EngTrqReqForRPM (CPU 0x7A908). Engine torque request vs pedal and RPM used at 0 kph (Park/Neutral and launch); blends to the normal pedal maps by 15 kph (KeDTRC_v_MinARM). Raise the 2500+ RPM columns to allow free rev to the fuel cut when stationary.
